eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Delhi (NCT) resident studying in Classes I–XII in recognised Delhi school; non-NCT NCR excluded.
eligibility_criteria.age_range: School students in Classes I–XII (up to 19 years)
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: 100% up to ₹60,000; 75% for ₹60,001–₹2,00,000 (check older/updated ₹3,00,000 slabs [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION])
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: SC/ST/OBC/Minority; >=50% marks previous year, >=75%–80% attendance where applicable [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: Regular Classes I–XII student; no repeat class.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Repeaters, <50% marks, and non-NCT NCR residents.

benefit.summary_hi: ₹48,000/वर्ष तक या वास्तविक शुल्क (जो कम हो [अधिसूचना सत्यापित करें]); ₹60,000 आय तक 100% व ₹2 लाख तक 75% ट्यूशन शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति।
benefit.summary_en: Up to ₹48,000/year or actual fee paid (whichever is less [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]; 100% up to ₹60,000 income, 75% for ₹60,001–₹2,00,000).
